interface.longDescription: SKILL ANALYZER 1.3.0 menggabungkan spesialis analisis, Universal AI Invocation Gateway, layanan cloud Remote MCP + HTTP API, dan Universal Access Manager. Access Manager mengorkestrasi enam subskill untuk consumer API key, autentikasi MCP, konektor MCP/API eksternal, credential vault, serta identity dan policy. Paket ini menyediakan spesifikasi skill dan kontrak routing portabel; penerbitan key, penyimpanan secret, dan koneksi outbound baru aktif setelah backend adapter, persistent store, KMS/secret manager, policy enforcement, serta egress controls tersedia dan diuji. Layanan cloud yang ada memverifikasi token OIDC eksternal, merutekan command, menggunakan provider model OpenAI-compatible, Redis rate limiting, dan metadata-only audit. Tidak mengklaim sub-agent independen atau tool execution yang belum dikonfigurasi.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this problem using the four-stage SKILL ANALYZER workflow: select methods, investigate causes, challenge risks, and engineer practical solutions.
Audit this framework critically: identify evidence gaps, root-cause weaknesses, failure modes, and testable improvements.
Stress-test this strategy and convert material findings into preventive controls, implementation steps, and evaluation criteria.

name: skill-analyzer
description: Sistem analisis modular dengan Universal AI Invocation Gateway, Universal Access Manager, Remote MCP, HTTP API, autentikasi OIDC, routing terpusat, dan logging terkontrol.
